The U.S. Justice Department has charged 19 individuals in Pennsylvania with healthcare fraud involving over $4 million in false claims to Medicare and Medicaid. The schemes involved home healthcare workers and company owners who billed for services that were never performed. Some defendants were found to be billing while in prison, hospitalized, or vacationing in the Caribbean and Europe. The FBI and the Fraud Division emphasized that this behavior diverts critical resources from patients who genuinely need care.
